=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text s1 "Hello, World!"
text s2 "The Quick Brown Fox Jumps Over The Lazy Dog."
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
fn rot13 a view uchar * to void
r = new uchar 256 0
for i ulong len a
c = get a i
if and ge c 65 le c 90
c = add rem add sub c 65 13 26 65
else
if and ge c 97 le c 122
c = add rem add sub c 97 13 26 97
end
end
put r i c
end
emit part r 0 len a
emit nl
end
fn main to int
rot13 s1
rot13 s2
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
Uryyb, Jbeyq!
Gur Dhvpx Oebja Sbk Whzcf Bire Gur Ynml Qbt.
</pre>
